prompt: whats the difference between a litellm virtual key and a team, and when should i use which?

thread.text: whats the difference between a litellm virtual key and a team, and when should i use which?

reference_reply: A virtual key is the credential an app sends to the proxy and a team is the group that owns keys and holds shared budgets, model access, and members. Use them together: create a team per group or project, then issue virtual keys under it. Use a standalone key only for a one-off integration that does not need shared limits.
